# .github/ci/ctest_exclusions.txt -- the engine tests the no-disc lanes do NOT run, one anchored
# regex per line (joined with '|' into `ctest -E`). build.sh --tests, build.ps1 -Tests and
# .github/workflows/ci.yml all read THIS file, so there is one list. Every row names its reason;
# a row whose reason is gone must be deleted.
#
# None of these is "flaky": each fails for a stated, reproducible reason on a fresh checkout of
# the pinned engine commit with no disc.

# ---- 1. Title lanes: need the extracted game files (Root*) or the frozen original tree (Og*,
#         PS2R_OLD_ROOT). The Og* rows SKIP 77 here already; Root* is the engine's own CI exclusion.
^Root
^Og

# ---- 2. Engine tests pinned to another title. They read that title's tables and fixture layout
#         (games/<title>/verify/baseline, verify/platform_ref/, verify/restore_mhash_expected.tsv,
#         symbols/build_symbols.py, a 298-row sdk_bindings.tsv, its retail argv string) instead of
#         skipping when the title in games/ has none. Upstream fix: parametrise on the title or
#         SKIP 77.
^RecompDispatchTableLink$
^RecompManifestIntact$
^RecompSymbolCensus$
^LintSdkBindingRowCount$
^LintSdkBindingNoGameAddress$
^SdkBindingManifestResolves$
^LibmpegBindings$
^BootEnvRetailArgv$
^Render_AttractReplaySelftest$
^VuVifGifSectionsAnchors$
^TitleSymbolsTableSelftest$
^VerifyAnchorsTable$
^VerifyAnchorsTableSelftest$
^VerifyDiffLegsSelftest$
^VerifyScoreSelftest$
^VerifyBatterySelftest$
^VerifyLegSpecSelftest$
^VerifyFreezeSessionLegSelftest$
^VerifyPlatformIdentitySelftest$
^VerifyProbeImagesSelftest$
^VerifyAttributeSelftest$
^VerifyApplyRebaselineSelftest$
^VerifyGateRunSelftest$
^VerifyScenePairingSelftest$
^VerifyRetirementGateSelftest$

# ---- 3. Tests of the three targets that do not build at the pinned engine commit
#         (app/gui/restart.cmake, clock.cmake: see .github/ci/known_broken_targets.txt).
^SessionRestart$
^SessionRestartRuntime$
^SessionRestoreDeadline$

# ---- 4. Engine component regressions at the pinned commit (be7386a), reproduced on a fresh build:
#         the "one stored-alpha convention" change re-pinned test_gl_alpha_convention and
#         test_blend_ff_map but not Present_DrawScanoutSource, and LibsdModule's ordinal-16
#         expectation predates the IOP-hosting work. To be fixed in the engine; remove the rows
#         when green. (Render_BlendEquationPin was the third: its texture upload still used the
#         pre-convention x2 alpha; re-pinned to stored alpha bytes in the engine working tree.)
^Present_DrawScanoutSource$
^LibsdModule$
